# ASP.NET Core

- ASP-001: Prefer requesting dependencies as constructor parameters over resolving services from RequestServices. Services resolved from the container should never be disposed by the developer. CRF-020 carries the rest of Microsoft's dependency injection guidance (the service locator pattern, stateful static classes and members, direct instantiation of dependent classes).
- ASP-008: Apps should be written and tested to never depend on cached data: code should always have a fallback option to fetch the data. Don't insert external input into the cache, and avoid using external user input directly in cache keys. Do not cache user-specific data that may be retrieved by other user requests.
- ASP-011: For protection against overposting, view models are recommended rather than the [Bind] attribute. [BindProperty] should not be used on models containing properties that should not be changed by the client. Don't apply [FromBody] to more than one parameter per action method. For a string-to-type conversion that doesn't require external resources or multiple inputs, creating a type converter or using TryParse is recommended.
- ASP-017: A gRPC channel should be reused when making gRPC calls. Prefer asynchronous programming with async and await when calling gRPC methods. Always dispose streaming calls once they're no longer needed. Configuring a gRPC call deadline is recommended. When calling gRPC services from an ASP.NET Core app, consider the gRPC client factory integration.
- ASP-024: A delegating handler for an HttpClient must be registered in DI as a transient service, rather than singleton or scoped.
